title: Clean Sweep
description: A crew member returning after a busy day wants one click to clear their whole inbox — but marking all as read must never touch messages that were already read, nor anyone else's inbox.
successCondition: As a customer, generate at least 3 distinct notifications (e.g. book 3 shipments), then manually mark exactly one of them read via POST /api/notifications/:id/read. POST /api/notifications/read-all returns 200 with marked equal to 2 (only the still-unread ones). GET /api/notifications afterward shows unreadCount 0 and every notification's read field true. A second, separate customer account's own unrelated notifications (created before or after this test) remain unaffected — check their read/unread state didn't change.
hints: Wait for each booking's notification to actually land (past the queue delay) before manually marking one read, or you may mark the wrong one, or none yet.

Set up the second, unrelated customer's notifications first and record their read states before running the read-all call on the first customer, so you have a real "before" snapshot to compare against.
